name: vaulty-skeleton
description: Vaulty Skeleton monorepo — zero-knowledge client-side vault SDK (@vaulty/core) and three showcase apps (GhostDrop, CryptKeep, InkVault).

scripts.dev:ghostdrop: npm run build:core && npm run dev --workspace ghostdrop
scripts.dev:cryptkeep: npm run build:core && npm run dev --workspace cryptkeep
scripts.dev:inkvault: npm run build:core && npm run dev --workspace inkvault
scripts.build:all: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace ghostdrop && npm run build --workspace cryptkeep && npm run build --workspace inkvault
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
